svg.aria-label: A pocket's rim rounded, then an upright corner of the pocket rounded by more: kentron's rim swings round the corner in a horn torus, and the corner's round stops at the torus's apex in a ledge; OCCT's rim is mitred there, and the round runs on up the mitre's crease.
svg.text: the round ends in a ledge under the torus
a mitred rim: the round runs on along its crease
